hook: Federal flood buyouts moved households out of risk zones, but wealthier, whiter neighborhoods gained most.
hook_turn: but wealthier, whiter neighborhoods gained most.
summary: Households in the US FEMA buyout program were more likely to move out of flood hazard areas and saw short-term debt reductions. Gains were larger in wealthier, predominantly white neighborhoods. The study compares similar mapped flood risk using national records, and benefit-cost ratios of 0.84 to 1.28 depend on assumed costs.
title: Does government-assisted relocation help households.
